idea-plugin.name: i18n Format
idea-plugin.description:
面向 Vue / i18n 项目的译文辅助工具：在代码中直接看到 i18n key 对应的中文，并支持按「译文」反查代码里的引用位置。

功能

  • 译文内联提示：在 Vue / JavaScript / TypeScript 中，$t('login.title')、t("login.title") 等 key 后会以灰字显示对应译文，无需跳转语言文件。
  • 当前文件译文搜索：按 Ctrl+F 打开原生查找栏时，下方会出现 I18n 译文搜索条。输入中文译文后，自动在语言 JSON 中匹配 key，并在当前文件高亮所有引用处。
  • 全局译文搜索：按 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F 打开仿「在文件中查找」的搜索窗口，按文件分组列出整个工程中引用该译文的代码位置。

使用说明

1. 配置语言文件
打开 Settings → I18n Inline Hint，填写语言 JSON 路径（相对项目根目录，最多 5 个），默认 src/locales/zh.json。内联提示与两种搜索都基于这里配置的文件。

2. 当前文件译文搜索（Ctrl+F）

  • 按 Ctrl+F，在原生查找栏下方输入译文，如「登录」；输入过程中自动搜索，无需回车。
  • ↑ / ↓ 在命中项之间切换，状态栏显示「第 2/5 处」。
  • 命中处使用主题选中色高亮并带圆角框；清空输入即清除高亮。
  • 右侧「全局搜索」链接可直接打开全局搜索窗口。

3. 全局译文搜索（Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F）

  • 输入译文后自动检索全工程，结果按文件分组显示，文件名后是「N 处」，子项显示行号、译文与 key。
  • ↑ / ↓ 切换选中项，Enter 或双击跳转到对应文件并关闭窗口。
  • 检索范围为工程内的 vue / ts / js / jsx / tsx / html 文件，自动跳过 node_modules、dist、build、.git 等目录，单次最多返回 300 处结果。

匹配规则

  • 译文匹配为「包含关键字、忽略大小写」：输入「登录」可命中「请先登录」「登录成功」。
  • 代码匹配为字符串字面量 'key' 与 "key"，支持单引号与双引号写法。

环境要求

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.3 及以上（开发与验证版本为 2024.2.6）。
  • 内置 JavaScript/TypeScript 与 Vue 插件（IDEA 旗舰版默认自带）。

English

A translation helper for Vue / i18n projects: see the Chinese text of i18n keys directly in code, and search code by translation text.

Features

  • Translation inlay hints: in Vue / JavaScript / TypeScript, keys such as $t('login.title') or t("login.title") show their translation as a gray inlay hint, so you do not need to open the locale file.
  • In-file translation search: press Ctrl+F and an I18n search bar appears under the native find bar. Type a translation (e.g. “login”), and the plugin resolves matching keys from the locale JSON and highlights every occurrence in the current file.
  • Global translation search: press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F to open a “Find in Files” style window that lists, grouped by file, every place in the project that references the translation.

How to use

1. Configure locale files
Open Settings → I18n Inline Hint and fill in the locale JSON paths (relative to the project root, up to 5 files). The default is src/locales/zh.json. Inlay hints and both search features use these files.

2. In-file translation search (Ctrl+F)

  • Press Ctrl+F and type a translation in the I18n bar under the native find bar; results update as you type, no Enter needed.
  • Use ↑ / ↓ to move between matches; the status shows “2/5”.
  • Matches are highlighted with the theme selection color and a rounded box; clearing the input removes the highlights.
  • The Global Search link on the right opens the global search window.

3. Global translation search (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F)

  • Type a translation and the whole project is searched automatically. Results are grouped by file — the file name is followed by “N occurrences”, and each child row shows the line number, translation and key.
  • Use ↑ / ↓ to change the selection; press Enter or double-click to open the file and close the window.
  • Searches vue / ts / js / jsx / tsx / html files in the project, skips node_modules, dist, build, .git and similar folders, and returns at most 300 results per search.

Matching rules

  • Translations are matched by “contains keyword, case-insensitive”: “login” also matches “please login first” and “login succeeded”.
  • Code is matched on string literals 'key' and "key" — both single and double quotes are supported.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.3 or later (developed and verified on 2024.2.6).
  • The bundled JavaScript/TypeScript and Vue plugins (included in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate by default).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.7

  • 新增「当前文件译文搜索」：按 Ctrl+F 时在原生查找栏下方显示 I18n 译文搜索条，输入译文即可匹配 key 并在当前文件高亮，支持 ↑↓ 切换、主题色圆角高亮。
  • 新增「全局译文搜索」：按 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F 打开仿「在文件中查找」的窗口，结果按文件分组显示行号与译文，支持 ↑↓ 切换、Enter 或双击跳转。
  • 译文搜索条右侧新增「全局搜索」入口。
  • 重写插件说明与变更说明，补充完整的中文使用文档与英文版本。
  • 优化搜索逻辑：译文按「包含关键字、忽略大小写」匹配，修复输入较长译文时搜不到结果的问题。

English — 1.0.7

  • New in-file translation search: pressing Ctrl+F shows an I18n search bar under the native find bar; typing a translation resolves matching keys and highlights all occurrences in the current file, with ↑↓ navigation and theme-colored rounded highlights.
  • New global translation search: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F opens a Find-in-Files style window with results grouped by file, showing line numbers and translations; navigate with ↑↓ and jump with Enter or double-click.
  • Added a “Global Search” link on the right side of the in-file search bar.
  • Rewrote the plugin description and change notes with complete Chinese documentation and an English version.
  • Improved search matching: translations are matched by “contains keyword, case-insensitive”, fixing cases where longer translations returned no results.
